evidence: Silver pendant with an Abbasid-type dirham (centre 'la ilaha illa / Allah wahdahu / la sharika lahu') in a wide round frame: an outer diamond-cut twisted rim, an openwork ring of filigree scrolls with polished teardrop leaves, a faceted inner bezel, and a diamond-cut bail. No catalog piece has this frame.
candidates_rejected: g7-02 (#1243): the frame is completely different. #1243 is a narrow scalloped loop-edge (lace) frame with no outer twisted rim and no scroll or teardrop ring, so it is not the same pendant, whatever the coin. g7-01 (#1242) is a filigree necklace with five small flower medallions. g5-32 (#931-941) has square Almohad-type coins. No other coin pieces exist.

evidence: Gold pendant with an Abbasid gold dinar of al-Mutawakkil ('lillah / Muhammad / rasul / Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam / al-Mutawakkil 'ala Allah' on the reverse, f016). The mount is an outer ring of round gold beads around a diamond-cut slanted band, with a tube bail and four wire claw clips on the back. No catalog piece matches.
candidates_rejected: g2-21 (#317): the frame is a twisted rope rim with a diamond-cut band (no bead ring), and the coin is an anonymous early Abbasid dinar (3-line 'Muhammad rasul Allah' reverse with no caliph name), so both coin and frame differ. g5-18 (#878): cast leopard over the coin, green pear drop, plain frame; its reverse layout also differs. g4-44 (#766): brooch with a large bead ring and three turquoise drops on chains, with a pin on the back. g4-46 (#770): filigree scroll frame with a heart and one green drop, with a pin on the back.

evidence: Loose oval white/lavender agate seal, 'Rabbi 'afini wa la tu'aqibni' in three ruled lines of early Kufic, with fan-shaped palmette finials at both ends of the middle line, a notched/dotted border and orange-brown spots near one end. No catalog piece shows this engraving.
candidates_rejected: g3-33 (#557/#558): milky chalcedony on a cage shank, but it has large cursive script and no ruled lines. g3-20 (#511/#513) is a red carnelian with naskh. g5-17 (#874), g5-43 (#983) and g5-27 are round square-Kufic stones. g7-06, g7-10, g7-12, g6-19, g5-44, g5-45 and g3-27 are white chalcedony with cursive text. Pale and Kufic stones on every board were checked.

evidence: Same gold bracelet (filed W, files R024-1..7): five oval engraved agate plaques in granulated filigree frames held by claws, alternating pearl drops and filigree heart drops, and filigree box clasps at both ends. Every stone agrees in content and order. Stone 1 by the clasp has two horizontal lines starting with the Basmala. Stone 2 has a large 'Ya Allah' in a cartouche with a border (v22 f023 = #1321). The large centre stone has a cartouche reading 'la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu min al-zalimin' in 3 lines, with a Fatiha border (v22 f010 = #1324). Stone 4 has the same Yunus verse in its cartouche with a Nad-e Ali border, and a small dark spot at the lower right (v22 f025 = #1325). Stone 5 is octagonal (cut corners) with the Basmala and Surat al-Ikhlas (v22 f025 = #1321/#1326). Photos compared: #1321, #1322, #1324, #1325, #1326.
candidates_rejected: g2-36 (#393) is a single cream stone with two loops. No other multi-stone gold piece exists.

evidence: Scalloped, shield-shaped jade plaque engraved with Ayat al-Kursi in thuluth ('Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayy al-qayyum la ta'khudhuhu sinatun...'), with a hinged silver cap at the top on a green cord. No catalog piece matches.
candidates_rejected: g4-17 (#652/#654) is a triangular grey-green jade with the Nad-e Ali prayer in a thin rope frame: different shape and text. g5-40 (#972) is a round talismanic green stone. g3-16 (#494) is an Ayat al-Kursi ring on a small rectangular stone. g7-34 (Ring-3) is a chalcedony ring.

evidence: Loose heart-shaped agate (orange body, pale engraved face). The centre is a heart cartouche with 'Muhammad nabi Allah' in large thuluth on a cross-hatched ground, an inner border with the Basmala and Surat al-Ikhlas, and an outer border with the Basmala and al-Fatiha (two concentric bands). No catalog piece matches.
candidates_rejected: g7-28 (#1357/#1360): orange heart on a cord, but the centre is a single 'Allah' with leaf fillers and only one border. g1-05 (#15): heart in a scrolled frame with the same layout family, but different centre words (not 'Muhammad nabi Allah'). g5-39 (#970): heart carnelian with two centre lines and one Ikhlas border. g2-13 (#277/#278): pear-shaped stone reading 'Ali' with a Nad-e Ali border. g3-30 (#548) is a pear ring with different text.

evidence: Mughal-style silver/gilt necklace: a teardrop engraved brown stone (with 'Muhammad...') in a ring of turquoise cabochons, coral bead fringe on coiled wire, gilt leaf pendants, turquoise-set diamond links and a heavy chain. No similar piece in any board.
candidates_rejected: g1-03 (#9): an oval honey agate pendant with a turquoise surround and fleur bail, with no coral or fringe. g6-09 (#1064): a square jadau pendant. g7-01 (#1242): a coin necklace. No R020/R021 file names exist in timeline.json.
